items.longBusinessSummary: Dell Technologies Inc. designs, develops, manufactures, markets, sells, and supports various comprehensive and integrated solutions, products, and services in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and internationally. The company operates through Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) and Client Solutions Group (CSG) segments. The ISG segment provides modern and traditional storage solutions, including all-flash, purpose-built, hyper-converged infrastructure, software-defined storage, and general-purpose and AI-optimized servers. This segment also offers networking products and services comprising wide area network infrastructure, data center and edge networking switches, and cables and optics that help its business customers to transform and modernize their infrastructure and complementing its server and storage solutions; and software, peripherals, and services, including consulting and support, and deployment. The CSG segment provides notebooks, desktops, and workstations and branded peripherals that include displays, docking stations, keyboards, mice, webcam and audio devices, and third-party software and peripherals; and configuration, and extended warranties services. The company is involved in originating, collecting, and servicing customer financing arrangements and offers payment and consumption solutions and services, such utility, subscription, as-a-service, leases, and loans, as well as fixed-term leases and loans. It serves enterprises, governmental agencies and other public institutions, educational institutions, healthcare organizations, small and medium-sized businesses, and consumers. The company has a strategic alliance with Rafay Systems for the development of AI infrastructure solutions. The company was formerly known as Denali Holding Inc. and changed its name to Dell Technologies Inc. in March 2013. Dell Technologies Inc. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Round Rock, Texas.

Title: Lenovo's Global Footprint Strengthens Its Growth Resilience
Author: Tanuka De   Thu, September 24, 2026 at 6:52 PM GMT+2 2 min read
Published: 2026-09-24T16:52:00+00:00
=== BODY ===
Lenovo Group's LNVGY geographically diversified business model reduces its reliance on any single market while positioning the company to capture growth across varying economic conditions. Lenovo operates in 180 markets, supported by more than 20 R&D locations and over 30 manufacturing sites across 11 markets, giving it a combination of global scale and local execution capabilities.Its revenue mix highlights this diversification. In the latest full fiscal year, the Americas contributed 34% of revenues, China 22%, EMEA 25% and Asia Pacific excluding China 19%, with no single region accounting for the majority of sales. This broad exposure is particularly important because demand for PCs, smartphones and enterprise technology can differ significantly across regions. Stronger performance in one market can therefore help offset weakness elsewhere.Lenovo's global footprint also supported growth, with fiscal 2026 revenues increasing 20% year over year to $83.1 billion. Its operating model combines global resources with local delivery across design, demand planning, procurement, manufacturing, marketing, sales and services.The company's diversified manufacturing network further enhances supply-chain flexibility, allowing Lenovo to adjust production as costs, demand patterns or market conditions change. Alongside expanding opportunities in AI, infrastructure and services, this global presence provides a solid foundation for more balanced and potentially resilient long-term growth.
HP Inc. HPQ maintains a strong global presence, serving customers across diverse countries and regions. HP offers innovative personal computing, printing, and digital solutions that support businesses, professionals, and consumers worldwide. Through innovation, strategic partnerships, and customer-focused initiatives, HP continues to strengthen its international footprint and deliver technology solutions globally.Dell Technologies DELL maintains a significant global presence, serving customers across diverse markets worldwide. Dell delivers a broad range of technology solutions, including computers, servers, storage systems and IT infrastructure. Through continuous innovation, strategic collaborations and customer-focused services, Dell strengthens its international operations while enabling organizations to achieve their digital transformation goals globally.
Shares of Lenovo have skyrocketed 285.1% year to date, outperforming the industry.
Lenovo's shares are trading at a discount compared with its industry. The company's forward 12-month price-to-sales multiple of 0.49 is lower than its industry average of 9.23.
The Zacks Consensus Estimate for LNVGY fiscal second- and third-quarter 2027 EPS did not witness any movement in the past 30 days. The same holds true for fiscal 2027 and 2028.The consensus estimates for LNVGY's fiscal 2027 and 2028 revenues and earnings indicate year-over-year increases.

Title: Dell Slips 2.34% as $999 Googlebook Tests Premium AI PCs
Author: Khac Phu Nguyen   Thu, September 24, 2026 at 8:04 PM GMT+2 1 min read
Published: 2026-09-24T18:04:13+00:00
=== BODY ===
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Dell Technologies (NYSE:DELL), the enterprise-infrastructure and personal-computing company, launched its first XPS Googlebook, pushing the premium brand into Google's Gemini-powered laptop ecosystem. Shares fell about 2.3% to $536.98 at 10.33am ET time on Thursday morning.
Warning! GuruFocus has detected 7 Warning Sign with DELL.
Is DELL fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.
The 13-inch machine starts at $999, powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon X Elite processor with up to 32 gigabytes of memory and on-device AI capabilities. Gemini sits at the center of the experience, while Android integration lets users move files, notifications and app activity between their phones and laptops with less friction.
The product gives Dell a fresh consumer-AI angle, but the valuation leaves little room for a slow start. At $536.98, the stock trades 132.06% above its GF Value of $231.40. Without disclosed shipment targets, margin guidance or market-share ambitions, strong sell-through will need to prove that Gemini and Android continuity can justify premium XPS pricing.
